Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from deepgram import DeepgramClient, PrerecordedOptions

def batch_transcribe_with_timestamps(audio_url: str, api_key: str) -> list[dict]:
    client = DeepgramClient(api_key=api_key)
    options = PrerecordedOptions(
        model="nova-2",
        smart_format=True,
    )
    
    response = client.listen.prerecorded.v("1").transcribe_url({"url": audio_url}, options)
    
    channels = response.results.channels
    if not channels or not channels[0].alternatives:
        return []
        
    alternatives = channels[0].alternatives[0]
    words = alternatives.words if alternatives.words else []
    
    return [
        {"word": w.word, "start": w.start, "end": w.end}
        for w in words
    ]
